title: What People Get Wrong About Induced Demand
summary: Explains induced demand beyond roads, showing that it applies to transit, walking and cycling infrastructure too but with different consequences. It corrects common misunderstandings of the concept.
why: HN recommends it as a clear treatment of induced demand across transport modes whenever threads debate road expansion versus transit.

quote.text: had a pretty good video on induced demand as it applies to both car transit and public transit
